description.value: Pearsons European Deli is a family-run breakfast-and-lunch cafe on Harvey Ave in Kelowna, operated by Red Seal Chef Stephanie Schoales and her husband Landon, who took over from the founding Pearson family after 30 years. The deli is known for hearty, house-made European-style food including build-your-own sandwiches, daily soups, and deli salads. Cyclists rolling through Kelowna will find a broad midday menu with vegan and vegetarian options and online ordering available.
